content:
Oh, Nefertiti, Beautiful One Has Come,

Queen of the Nile, radiance of the sun,

Whose name whispers through the sands of time,

A testament to beauty, grace, and divine rhyme.

We offer our hearts, open and sincere,

To you, Queen Mother, dispelling all fear.

Your image, a beacon, a face of serenity,

A reminder of hope, and of life's vitality.

We thank you for beauty, both within and without,

For guiding our steps when we're filled with doubt.

We thank you for strength, for unwavering might,

And for filling the world with your radiant light.

May we strive to embody the qualities you hold dear,

Compassion and kindness, casting out all fear.

May your wisdom guide us, your spirit enfold,

And stories of your reign forever be told.

We pray for your blessings, for peace and for grace,

To see beauty in all, in every time and space.

Oh, Nefertiti, we honor your name,

And keep your memory, a forever burning flame.

Kheper-em-ib-ek, Nefertiti! (May you be well!)
